cur-city-dhar-tichitt.placeNote: Pinned at the Tichit escarpment in Mauritania. The settlements run for hundreds of kilometres along the cliffs rather than sitting at one point, so any single pin is a convenience.
cur-city-dhar-tichitt.dateNote: Stone-walled compounds occupied from roughly 2000 to 300 BCE — the oldest known settlements of their kind in West Africa, abandoned as the Sahara dried.

cur-mali-empire.placeNote: Pinned near Bamako, in the empire's heartland on the upper Niger. Where its capital stood (Niani, Dakajalan or elsewhere) is still debated, so this is not the site of a known city.
